conclusions.text: The exact pinned 311-feature simplified product contains all 19 target source feature IDs once; 34 components were compared to all selected complete features.

Compared with the exact simplified input, 5 of 34 components have no intersection and 29 have positive-area contact. This is a source-relative overlay result and does not establish administrative correctness.

Current Atlas contact geometries are not topologically equal to the simplified product; in the 646-pair matrix the products produce 10 different intersects outcomes and 19 different positive-area outcomes. Product distinction is material; cause is unresolved.
The separate CAOP2025 municipal overlay intersects 32 distinct components in 39 pairs; two components do not intersect a CAOP municipality polygon. This is an administrative-product comparison only.

Source authority/effective dates/accuracy/registration, physical land or water, candidate cause and rightful administration remain unknown for the full family; no source supports a component reclassification.

methods.area_method: pyproj.Geod.geometry_area_perimeter absolute area; independent Lambert azimuthal equal-area projection centered 38.2N, 28.2W for comparison; area does not mean land area.
methods.crs: geoBoundaries/current Atlas GeoJSON CRS84; component custody geometries interpreted as WGS84 longitude/latitude; DGT GeoPackages EPSG:5014 and EPSG:5015 transformed with pyproj always_xy.
methods.description: Compare every full component geometry to all 19 selected features from the exact simplified source product consumed by the pinned recipe; independently compare to current Atlas contact geometry and official CAOP2025 municipal polygons. No clipping, correction, geometry repair, snapping, buffering, simplification or fill.
methods.units: Unclipped intersection and coverage predicates; WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic square metres and independent Azores-centred LAEA square metres; counts are component-feature pairs.
